written.headline: NVIDIA and South Korea expand sovereign AI and physical AI collaboration
written.summary: NVIDIA and South Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT are expanding their collaboration across sovereign AI infrastructure, data centers, models, and talent development. Major Korean industry leaders including Samsung, LG, SK Telecom, Kakao Mobility, and Hyundai Motor Group are integrating NVIDIA accelerated computing, simulation software, autonomous driving platforms, and security tools.
